prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1159; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the parking lot collision referenced in your file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, in writing, or in person. Our client has been advised to decline any recorded statement or discussion of the incident with your representatives.

We request written confirmation of the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, together with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also disclose the identity of the assigned adjuster.

We further ask that your insureds and your company preserve all evidence relating to the incident. This includes photographs, dashcam or surveillance footage, vehicle telematics, repair estimates, the claim file, adjuster notes, and any recorded communications. Failure to preserve such material may result in sanctions in any later proceeding. We look forward to your prompt written response.
